moments.title: Halloween Weekend is Here
moments.blurb: Halloween falls on Saturday, October 31st, this year, with many events and school half-term holidays across the UK coinciding with the spooky celebrations.

angles.name: Spooky Season
angles.copy: It's officially Halloween week! Who's ready for trick-or-treating, pumpkin carving, and all things spooky? What are your plans for Saturday?

angles.name: Half-Term Horrors
angles.copy: With half-term for many schools falling right up to Halloween, the UK is packed with frightful fun! Are you heading to a scarefest or keeping it local?

angles.name: London Halloween
angles.copy: London's getting spooky! From the High Street Kensington Halloween trail to the Mystery Film Screening on a boat, how are you celebrating All Hallows' Eve?

moments.title: Jamie Miller Tops UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Cardiff-born singer Jamie Miller, 29, has scored his first UK Official Singles Chart number one with 'Babydoll', becoming the first Welsh artist in 15 years and first solo male Welsh artist in 41 years to achieve the feat.

angles.name: Welsh #1 History
angles.copy: HUGE NEWS for Welsh music! Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' is officially the UK #1 single. He's the first Welsh artist to top the charts in 15 years! An incredible achievement for the Cardiff star.

angles.name: Babydoll Viral Success
angles.copy: From viral dance trend to UK #1! Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' has taken over, and now it's officially number one. Who's been doing the 'Babydoll dance'?

angles.name: Chart Battle Win
angles.copy: A nail-biting finish, but Jamie Miller takes the top spot! 'Babydoll' beat Tate McRae's 'Housewife' to become the UK's number one single. Well deserved!

moments.title: Strictly Features Melanie C & Jamie Miller
moments.blurb: The Strictly Come Dancing results show on Sunday will feature a performance from Spice Girl Melanie C, plus UK chart-topper Jamie Miller and Antonio Cipriano performing their hit 'Babydoll'.

angles.name: Strictly Guest Stars
angles.copy: What a line-up for the Strictly results show tomorrow! Melanie C will be performing, plus new UK #1 Jamie Miller and Antonio Cipriano will be on the dancefloor with 'Babydoll'. Don't miss it!

angles.name: Mel C Back
angles.copy: Sporty Spice is back on our screens! Melanie C joins the Strictly professionals for a special performance on Sunday. Get ready to 'Sweat'!

angles.name: Jamie Miller TV Debut
angles.copy: Fresh from hitting UK #1, Jamie Miller and Antonio Cipriano make their UK television debut on Strictly tomorrow night! You know they'll be performing 'Babydoll'.

moments.title: Nigella Lawson on Great British Bake Off
moments.blurb: The 17th series of The Great British Bake Off continues weekly on Channel 4 on Tuesdays, with Nigella Lawson having joined Paul Hollywood as a new judge this season.

angles.name: Bake Off Week
angles.copy: Another week, another delicious challenge in the Bake Off tent! Who's excited for Tuesday's episode? What bakes are you hoping to see?

angles.name: Nigella's Touch
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a judge has brought a new flavour to the Bake Off tent this year! What do you think of the new judging duo?

moments.title: Celebrity Traitors Final Next Week
moments.blurb: The highly anticipated finale of the second series of The Celebrity Traitors is confirmed to air on BBC One on Friday, October 30th, at 8pm.

angles.name: Traitors Countdown
angles.copy: The ultimate game of deception is almost over! The Celebrity Traitors finale airs next Friday, October 30th. Who do you think will be unmasked, and who will take the prize?

angles.name: Longest Episode
angles.copy: Get ready for an extended dose of paranoia! The Celebrity Traitors final is set to be the longest episode ever, at 80 minutes. Perfect for Halloween eve!

moments.title: Duran Duran's Halloween Party

angles.name: Hungry Like The Wolf
angles.copy: Duran Duran are bringing their 'Danse Macabre Halloween Party' to The O2 next Saturday! Get your costumes ready for a night of iconic hits.

angles.name: Halloween Gig
angles.copy: Fancy a Halloween party with music legends? Duran Duran are wrapping up their UK tour with a special spooky show at London's O2 on October 31st.

moments.title: James Blake Continues UK Tour

angles.name: Blake in Manchester
angles.copy: James Blake brings his 'Trying Times Tour' to Manchester's New Century Hall tomorrow and Monday! Who's heading out for his immersive electronic sounds?

angles.name: Bristol Bound
angles.copy: Later this week, James Blake will be in Bristol for two nights at the O2 Academy. Don't miss out on tickets if you're in the South West!

moments.title: Premier League Weekend Fixtures

angles.name: Super Saturday Football

angles.name: Sunday Showdowns
angles.copy: More Premier League action tomorrow! Liverpool take on Brighton, and Man Utd face Bournemouth. Predictions, anyone?

angles.name: Happy Birthday Katy

angles.name: Pop Icon
angles.copy: Tomorrow, pop icon Katy Perry turns 42! From 'I Kissed A Girl' to 'Firework', her hits have defined a generation. What's her most iconic track for you?

angles.name: Happy Birthday Simon
angles.copy: The legendary voice of Duran Duran, Simon Le Bon, turns 68 on Tuesday! Get ready to celebrate a true 80s icon. What's your favourite Duran Duran track?

angles.name: Wild Boy
angles.copy: He's still 'Hungry Like The Wolf'! Simon Le Bon celebrates his 68th birthday this week. An absolute legend of rock and pop.

angles.name: Music Star
angles.copy: Celebrating Keith Urban's 59th on Monday! From Nashville to global stages, he's given us so many unforgettable songs.

moments.title: Storm Austen Disrupts Devon Rail
moments.blurb: Train services between Exeter St Davids and Okehampton remain suspended due to strong winds from Storm Austen, with replacement buses in operation and disruption expected to continue.

angles.name: Devon Train Chaos
angles.copy: Still major disruption for rail passengers in Devon! The Exeter St Davids to Okehampton line remains closed due to Storm Austen. Check before you travel!

angles.name: Storm Austen Impact
angles.copy: Strong winds from Storm Austen are still causing issues across Devon, including the ongoing closure of the Exeter-Okehampton railway. Stay safe out there!

moments.title: Severe Drought Declared in Devon
moments.blurb: A severe drought has been declared across parts of southern England, including Devon, following months of low rainfall, prompting calls for water conservation.

angles.name: Water Crisis
angles.copy: Devon is officially in a severe drought, with leaders blaming 'decades of neglect' by South West Water. Are you doing your bit to conserve water?

angles.name: Save Water
angles.copy: With severe drought declared in Devon, every drop counts. Simple steps can make a difference. What changes have you made to conserve water at home?

moments.title: Exeter Cyclists Fight Road Reopening
moments.blurb: Cyclists in Exeter are preparing for a legal battle to challenge plans to reopen Dryden Road, which was closed to cars during the Covid pandemic, to traffic.

angles.name: Dryden Road Battle
angles.copy: The battle over Exeter's Dryden Road continues! Cyclists are gearing up for a legal challenge against plans to reopen the Covid-closed route to cars. What's your view?

angles.name: City Centre Access
angles.copy: Should Dryden Road remain traffic-free for cyclists or be reopened to cars? Exeter residents are divided, and now it's heading to a legal fight.
